categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the research, development, production, and sales of optoelectronic devices and subsystems. Its product portfolio includes transmission products such as telecom transmission optical transceivers, optical amplifiers, transmission subsystems, and passive optical modules, as well as access and data communication products including broadband access and wireless access modules. The company also focuses on data center interconnection (DCI) products and various optical transceiver modules for short-distance data communication.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes proprietary technologies including high-speed optical device packaging, high-frequency circuit board design, long-distance transmission for optical transceivers, and advanced simulation and structural design techniques. It has developed integrated platforms for coherent and non-coherent optical modules, wide-spectrum optical amplifiers covering extended C and L bands, and advanced optical transmission subsystems. Manufacturing methods include vertical integration from chip packaging to subsystem assembly, supported by automated testing platforms and proprietary production processes.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include telecom equipment manufacturers, data communication equipment manufacturers, telecom operators, data operators, and private networks. Major clients are domestic and international companies such as ZTE, China Mobile, China Telecom, Infinera, Ciena, State Grid, FiberHome, China Unicom, Nokia, and ECI. The company serves markets in telecom backbone, bearer, access networks, 5G front-haul, metropolitan DCI, data center interconnection, and ultra-high voltage communication protection.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with significant domestic sales, while also expanding its global footprint through subsidiaries and offices in Singapore, Canada, Germany, Japan, South Korea, and Thailand. It has established a manufacturing base in Thailand and R&D centers in Canada and Singapore, forming a global value chain integrating R&D, manufacturing, and sales.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the optical communication supply chain, focusing on the design, manufacturing, and sales of optical devices and subsystems. It has strong vertical integration capabilities covering chip packaging, device assembly, module manufacturing, and subsystem integration, enabling comprehensive control over product quality and innovation.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the company prioritizes innovation in high-speed, long-distance, low-power optical modules, including coherent and non-coherent technologies, targeting 100G to 3.2T transmission rates. It invests heavily in R&D for DCI equipment, wide-spectrum amplifiers, data center optical modules, and optical transmission subsystems. The company also focuses on emerging technologies such as optical switching, co-packaged optics (CPO), and next-generation PON standards, aiming to lead in the evolving optical communication and computing infrastructure markets.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of optical devices, modules, and subsystems. The company employs a direct sales model supplemented by distributors, with sales contracts including standard product deliveries and customized solutions requiring installation and acceptance. It also earns income from government subsidies and investment returns related to its financial assets.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a high-tech leader in the optical communication industry with comprehensive horizontal and vertical integration capabilities. It holds a strong technological edge in long-distance optical transmission, wide-spectrum amplifiers, and high-speed optical modules. It competes with global optical device manufacturers and benefits from national strategic support, maintaining a competitive advantage through continuous innovation and diversified product offerings.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 841 million, a 2.79% increase year-over-year, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 100 million, up 9.07%. R&D investment accounted for 12.31% of revenue, reflecting a 25.20% increase in R&D spending. The company’s total assets reached RMB 2.62 billion with steady growth in net assets and cash flow from operations showing significant improvement.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its strong R&D capabilities, proprietary core technologies, and vertical integration to deliver high-performance, reliable, and cost-effective optical communication products. Its wide product portfolio addresses diverse customer needs across telecom, data center, and access networks. The company’s focus on innovation in high-speed transmission, wide-spectrum amplification, and integrated optical subsystems provides differentiated solutions that support next-generation communication infrastructure and computing networks.
